biomarkers.name: GNAQ / GNA11 mutations
biomarkers.clinical_use: Defining feature of uveal melanoma; distinguishes from most cutaneous melanoma. Activates MAPK/YAP signaling; supports pathway-directed clinical trials

biomarkers.name: BAP1 loss (germline or somatic)
biomarkers.prevalence: ~45-50% somatic/inactivated in primary tumours; germline causes BAP1 tumour predisposition syndrome
biomarkers.clinical_use: Strong predictor of metastasis and poor survival; often associated with monosomy 3. Germline: family screening/counseling (including mesothelioma, RCC, cutaneous melanoma, and other BAP1-TPDS-associated tumours)

biomarkers.name: SF3B1 mutations
biomarkers.clinical_use: Intermediate prognosis; associated with later-onset metastasis pattern

biomarkers.name: EIF1AX mutations
biomarkers.clinical_use: Best prognosis subset; low metastatic risk

biomarkers.name: Monosomy 3
biomarkers.clinical_use: Strong adverse prognostic marker; often co-occurs with BAP1 loss

biomarkers.name: Class 1 vs Class 2 gene expression profile (Castle Biosciences)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Class 1A/1B (lower risk), Class 2 (high risk of metastasis) — guides surveillance intensity

biomarkers.name: HLA-A*02:01 typing
biomarkers.clinical_use: Tebentafusp (gp100 × CD3 bispecific T-cell receptor therapy) — approved for unresectable/metastatic uveal melanoma in HLA-A*02:01+ patients; first therapy to show an overall survival benefit in this disease

biomarkers.name: gp100
biomarkers.prevalence: Expressed in melanocytic tumours including most uveal melanomas

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Melanocytic neoplasm arising from uveal tract (choroid ~85-90%, ciliary body, iris); spindle cell or epithelioid morphology
variants: spindle cell (spindle A, spindle B — better prognosis)
histomorphological_subtype.grading: Modified Callender classification (spindle < mixed < epithelioid); tumour size (COMS categories) drives management

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: 'Cold' — low TMB (not UV-driven despite ocular exposure), sparse TIL, immune-privileged eye microenvironment; IO monotherapy is largely ineffective

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Uveal melanocytes of choroid (~85-90%), ciliary body, or iris
cellular_states_and_lineage.developmental_lineage: Neural crest — uveal melanocytes migrated to ocular sites
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Melanocytic differentiation with same lineage markers as cutaneous (S100+, HMB-45+, Melan-A+, SOX10+, MITF+); Callender classification (spindle → epithelioid) reflects lineage state
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Distinct genomic biology from cutaneous — GNAQ/GNA11 mutations activate Gαq-PLCβ signaling rather than canonical BRAF-driven melanoma biology; BAP1 loss (often with chromosome 3 monosomy) drives metastatic potential; SF3B1 mutations produce distinct behaviour
